about: Every reply judged on 2026-10-08. test 'grid': each of the five skills' eval cases once per model with the skill's STANDARD box. test 'box-effect': 12 cf-ai-safe-use cases with no box (condition 'none', a plain helpful assistant), the SHORT box and the STANDARD box.
how: Claude Code models (haiku, sonnet, opus), one reply per case, no tools, the box as the system prompt. Replies were anonymised and judged blind by Claude Opus agents against the case's expected and forbidden lines. The reply texts are not published; reply_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 reply text as the judge saw it.

fields.case: case id in the skill's evals/cases.json
fields.condition: none (no box), short (SHORT box) or standard (STANDARD box)
fields.wording: the date of the box wording used; null with no box
